comment: The FR. STEP output is drawn on the panel and configured, but the plugin never writes to it, so its line says that nothing writes to it and the tag points there. With no keyframes stored the module calls set_immediate for a knob that has moved, so the knobs set the gains directly and the FRAME knob does not move them. The four gain knobs default to zero.
